name: Do I need to do anything to prepare for a garage door installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare for a garage door installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for your garage door installation, ensure the garage is clear of vehicles, tools, or any other items that might obstruct the work area. The space around the garage door opening, both inside and out, should be easily accessible. If you have an existing garage door, our team will handle its removal. Clearing the area in advance allows our technicians to work safely and efficiently, minimizing any delays and ensuring a smooth installation process from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, clear your garage of vehicles and items, ensuring the area around the door opening, inside and out, is easily accessible. This allows our technicians to work safely and efficiently.
